control: same residual model with no additional external features
residual: unclipped absolute actual minus robust28 anchor, fit MAE
selection: mean May/July score descending, then variant name; September diagnostic only
acceptance: at least .0001 gain on each May/July and no September regression versus robust28 AND independently recomputed published hybrid; source effect separately compared with residual base
availability: training target dates before outer origin; anchors and all dynamic source features strictly before each inner origin; no future actual weather; revised archive vintage remains unverified
calendar_caveat: robust28 already uses calendar; this tests incremental calendar features, not removal of all calendar information
research_context: Official fit supports real-valued regression labels; use explicit residual targets around existing strong anchor. Absolute residuals with MAE preserve organizer absolute error units. Fixed small correction guards weak sparse external covariates; no claim that bounds assure improvement.
invariants: scored CSV and serving assets unchanged; no new dependencies
